LOCATION: 88 Arkansas St, Unit 219, San Francisco, CA 94107
RENTWISE PRESENTS: NEW Bright, Modern Studio in Prime Potrero Hill with Designer Finishes & Luxe Amenities

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
* Be the first to live in this brand new designer studio unit
* Spacious studio layout with 374 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space
* Wide plank hardwood flooring throughout
* Floor-to-ceiling windows offering abundant natural light and elevated city views
* High-end modern kitchen featuring a Bertazzoni gas cooktop, oven, hood, and dishwasher
* Bosch refrigerator, quartz countertops, Barbosa cabinetry, and under-cabinet lighting
* Sleek bathroom with Barbosa vanity, Grohe fixtures, tiled shower, and back-lit mirror
* In-unit Bosch washer and dryer
* Air conditioning for year-round comfort
* RFID smart lock entry and Cat 6 wiring
* Fiber-speed internet available via Webpass or AT&T
* Private storage cage included in the secure community storage area
* Secure building with attended lobby, package delivery acceptance, and parcel storage room
* Shared amenities: community courtyard, rooftop lounge with BBQ, fire pit, and skyline views
* Bicycle storage and convenient dog wash station
* Street parking only - parking in this area is plentiful

LIVE IN THE HEART OF POTRERO HILL:
* Sun-soaked, vibrant neighborhood known for charm and walkability
* Steps from dog-friendly Jackson Parkplayground, sports courts, and green space
* Surrounded by popular cafes, restaurants, and boutique shops
* Whole Foods Market just blocks away
* Easy access to 101 & 280 freeways for a seamless commute
* Close to Mission Bay, Chase Center, Oracle Park, and Downtown SF
* Excellent public transportation, bike-friendly streets, and car-share access nearby

RENTAL TERMS
* Rent: $2,850/month
* Security Deposit: $2,850
* Utilities Included: Gas, garbage, and sewage
* Pet Policy: Small pets allowed with review and additional deposit
* Available: Now

BENEFITS OF RENTING WITH RENTWISE
* Easy online rent payment made through a secure online portal
* Online maintenance requests and a 24/7 maintenance hotline
* Personalized service from professional and responsive property managers

HOW TO APPLY
* Click "Apply Here" on the top of the page
* Select the property from the list
* Click "Apply Here"

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS
* All applicants must view unit before applications will be processed. No special treatment for applications received prior to viewing the unit.
* Applicants must provide a copy of their photo ID
* Applicants must provide proof of income (last two most recent pay stubs/offer letter/etc.)
* Application fee must be submitted with application
